text:
julia_sales: Heads-up — BigMerchant just sent a SIG/CAIQ + DPA follow-up. They flagged data deletion/DSAR flows and want to confirm we can support SCCs. POC kickoff tomorrow. Need input on what to send them asap.

alex_security: Thanks. Do we have a mapping doc between our controls and CAIQ questions? If not, I can pull the most common control IDs (e.g., CCM-01/CCM-02 equivalents) and the network isolation answers. Also: they asked about key management (KMS/HSM) and tenant separation.

sara_privacy: I have the DPA draft with the SCCs clause and our retention table. Main privacy ask will be: retention period for user-generated prompts, logs, and embeddings + deletion workflow for DSARs. We currently retain logs 90 days by default, embeddings 30 days for hosted trials unless customer requests deletion.

matt_dev: For the POC we usually offer hosted with a demo dataset, or Dedicated short-term reserved capacity for throughput tests. Pricing note: short-term Dedicated requires a minimum 2-week billing commit; we can offer a discounted eval rate. Which one does BigMerchant prefer? They also asked about canary fallbacks during the POC.

oliver_psm: Can we propose a 2-week eval on Dedicated with a scoped subset of model access + a written fallback plan? That addresses their reliability and segregation concerns. Action: send them the network diagram, DPA excerpt, and a simple deletion playbook. I'll own the POC runbook.

julia_sales: @alex_security @sara_privacy @oliver_psm please collate. BigMerchant wants answers by EOD PST. I'm attaching their SIG export (questions only). They flagged: "Do you have documented processes for DSAR handling? Are there contractual SCCs? Where are keys stored?"

alex_security: I can draft the CAIQ mapping and key answer. For HSM/KMS: we support customer-managed KMS for Private/Dedicated and Redwood-managed KMS for hosted. Short snippet to include: ```We support customer KMS (Cloud KMS/HSM) for Private and Dedicated; hosted option uses envelope encryption with Redwood-managed keys. Key rotation and access controls are logged and auditable.```

sara_privacy: For DSARs: we follow a documented workflow — intake -> identity verification -> scope -> locate -> delete/return -> confirm. Timeline: 30 days standard, 15 day extension if complex. For POC customers we can accelerate to 7 days for demo data. I'll paste the retention table to the thread after.

matt_dev: POC config we recommend: 1) Dedicated pool with a single GPU node, 2) model pinned to a quantized variant for cost, 3) prefix caching disabled unless they share real customer data. Example deploy snippet for the POC (config):
```
deployment: dedicated-eval
replicas: 1
model: open-llm-7b-quant
data_retention_days: 30
network: vpc-peering
```

oliver_psm: Also flag an enterprise blocker: legal wants a clause about data deletion certification for production deals. For POC we can provide a self-attestation and a deletion audit export (CSV) post-run. That should satisfy procurement for the trial.

julia_sales: Good. Two immediate asks for the EOD reply: 1) short answers to SIG CAIQ Qs they highlighted (controls, KMS, tenancy), 2) DPA excerpt showing SCCs + retention table + DSAR workflow.

alex_security: I'll push the CAIQ mapping draft by noon.

sara_privacy: Sending retention table + DSAR flow in 45m.

matt_dev: I'll prepare the POC pricing/options and minimal deploy snippet.

oliver_psm: I'll assemble the runbook and deletion audit sample; want to review before we send.

incidents-bot: Note — POC kickoff scheduled for 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC (automated entry).

julia_sales: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll package and send once we have the pieces. If anyone sees a contractual redline risk, flag it here.

alex_security: One more thing — BigMerchant asked about SCCs vs EU SCC replacements. We should confirm whether their legal needs the 2021 SCCs. If so, we need legal to rubber-stamp. @legal-team FYI.

sara_privacy: Noted. I'll loop legal after I paste the DPA excerpt.

oliver_psm: Post-send plan: 1) 24h SLA on Q&A, 2) weekly sync during POC, 3) final deletion certificate when POC ends.

julia_sales: Perfect. Everyone on this thread = please react with :white_check_mark: when your piece is uploaded.
